proof.record_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted lexicographically; compact separators; record_sha256 excluded from its own digest.
proof.root_construction: Sort records by id; concatenate '<id>:<record_sha256>\n'; SHA-256 the UTF-8 result.
proof.scope: The Git anchor proves that this exact registry/fingerprint set existed in the referenced commit. It does not by itself prove scientific correctness, peer review, patent priority, or disputed authorship.
proof.immutability_note: The live site may evolve. The anchor commit is content-addressed; changing its content produces a different commit SHA.

records.title: IAMBANDOBANDZ / Brandon Emery: From Rust Belt Survival to A.I-Mediated Music Evolution
records.scientific_status: Interpretive biographical research report; not peer reviewed.
records.summary: Documents the artist and systems-builder trajectory and proposes A.I.-assisted autobiographical continuity reconstruction as an interpretive frame.

records.title: The Living Lattice: Mycelial Fractal Architectures for Sovereign Self-Evolving Intelligence
records.scientific_status: Speculative architecture white paper; not peer reviewed. Contains claims that require independent reproduction and should not be treated as established results.
records.summary: A living-systems-inspired sovereign AI architecture combining sparse adaptive topology, recursive self-modeling, memory consolidation, cryptographic provenance, and modular skill growth.

records.title: Victor Genesis: From Experimental AI Scripts to a Synthetic Continuity System
records.scientific_status: Canonical technical architecture and evidence-gated build package; not a claim that Victor is presently AGI, conscious, or sentient.
records.summary: Defines Victor as a persistent, auditable, local-first continuity system whose identity, knowledge, and verified history survive replacement of cognitive models.

records.title: Auditory Replicating Information Agents (ARIA): A Unified Theory of Human Attention, Semantic Reconstruction, Cultural Transmission, and Human-Machine Acoustic Propagation
records.scientific_status: Independent research white paper / arXiv-style preprint; not peer reviewed.
records.summary: Models auditory information as a reconstructed latent pattern that may persist, mutate, and retransmit across consenting human or authorized machine hosts without claiming a literal sound virus or universal mind control.

records.title: Applied Human Attention Dynamics: Physics, Neuroscience, Psychoacoustics, Linguistics, Memory, Narrative, Suggestion, and Ethical Signal Design
records.scientific_status: Independent interdisciplinary preprint; not peer reviewed. Evidence synthesis plus testable field proposal.
records.summary: Proposes a consent-preserving engineering science for the probabilistic chain from physical signal through attention, semantic reconstruction, memory, and voluntary communication or action.

records.title: Informatron: A State-Transition Primitive for Semantic Physics, Causal Knowledge, and Governed Computational Agency
records.scientific_status: Research white paper and falsifiable engineering program; not a discovered physical particle, proven consciousness theory, or established scientific standard.
records.summary: Defines an Informatron as a canonical typed, provenance-preserving, authority-bounded state transition that can alter a living computational model of reality.

records.title: Temporal Sovereignty: Human Time as a Missing Accounting Layer in AI, Economics, Attention, and Automation
records.scientific_status: Conceptual framework and research proposal; proposed metrics are not yet validated psychometric, economic, or regulatory standards.
records.summary: Distinguishes time saved from time returned and proposes agency-adjusted accounting for whether automation returns finite lifetime to human control.

records.title: Povertoral Predisposition: The Probability Distribution Inherited Before the First Choice
records.scientific_status: Active hypothesis and predictive research program; synthetic PEV-1 controls are not population evidence.
records.summary: Models birth-assigned constraints as a path-dependent probability distribution over capability, exposure, shocks, and escape rather than a personal defect.

records.title: Sovereign Intelligence, Creator Infrastructure, and the Victor Architecture
records.summary: Connects creator ownership, Massive Magnetics, Ethica AI, B Heard Network, and Victor into a single sovereign intelligence and distribution ecosystem.

records.title: Victor AGI Multiverse Stack
records.scientific_status: Legacy technical white-paper-level architecture; historical claims require reproduction before reuse.
records.summary: Early modular Victor substrate spanning autodiff, replay memory, event buses, fractal NLP, attention, plugin systems, and multiverse runtime ideas.

records.title: The Fractal Whitepaper (Draft)
records.scientific_status: Legacy draft. Historical benchmark claims are unverified until reproduced.
records.summary: Early fractal architecture and quantization work preserved for technical lineage and future benchmark reproduction.

records.title: Victor White Paper / Intellectual Property Protection Chain
records.scientific_status: Verified white-paper creation chain; exact final historical title and artifact remain unresolved.
records.summary: A Victor architecture white-paper and IP-protection sequence created in April 2025, preserved as priority and lineage evidence.

records.title: MetaWolf Synthetic Research-Styled Artifact Set
records.scientific_status: Not legitimate scientific research. Retained only as provenance for an abandoned synthetic knowledge-pack experiment.
records.summary: Fourteen synthetic research-styled artifacts are preserved as historical provenance only. Deceptive or operational framing from the abandoned experiment is not endorsed or reproduced.
